requirement: Sign-out ends the session on the server: a copied tracy_sess cookie no longer signs in or renews, while sessions minted before the change keep working until they expire

oracle.ref: PR #1182 (fix); fix evidence: E2E 04/10/2026 J1.3 (tasks/evidence/e2e-full-dev/2026-10-04): an old tracy_sess cookie still signed in after POST /auth/signout on cowork.tracy.site.
oracle.invariant: 'a cookie used after sign-out no longer signs anyone in' is ok: GET /auth/me with the cookie answers the email, POST /auth/signout with it answers 200, the same cookie on GET /auth/me then answers email null (pre-fix: still the email, for up to 72 h). 'a signed-out session cannot be renewed back to life' is ok: after sign-out and more than an hour, GET /auth/me answers email null and sets no cookie. 'a renewed cookie belongs to the same sign-in' is ok: signing out with the pre-renewal cookie also ends the renewed one. 'signing out one sign-in leaves another sign-in of the same person alone' is ok. 'a token minted before jti existed is still accepted until it expires' is ok, and 'renewing an old jti-less token hands out one that sign-out can end' is ok. 'the wire format is the one every signed-in browser is already holding' is ok.
